text:
alice: quick scenario check-- EU-residency tenant pins to eu-central, but a subset of traffic lands in us-east during a regional surge. we need a simple contract for writes that balances availability + legal constraints.
bernard: two simple ops we can expose: (A) strict-reject -> 451 if not in eu; (B) escrow-accept -> 202 + local encrypted buffer + async replay. let tenants pick per-tenant or per-request with header `X-Residency-Mode`.
carmen: operationally: escrow implies we must provide visibility (status endpoint + webhook) and retention TTL. recommend default TTL=72h, with per-tenant override.
alice: ordering concerns: many customers don't need strong ordering, but billing/ledger ones do. propose paid "ordered-replay" flag that enforces per-tenant sequence numbers for replay.
bernard: implementation sketch: escrow record = plain stringified JSON (no PII in logs), fields: client_req_id, idempotency_key, schema_version, orig_region, consent_flag. repaid with tenant KEK. background replay worker picks records, validates schema on eu-primary. if schema mismatch -> quarantine + alert + manual operator step, do not drop.
legal-bot: legal note: escrowed PII needs tenant consent or contract exception. default must be deny. Add consent flag check on ingest.
ops-bot: Incident detector: eu-central degraded 2024-02-11T19:23Z flagged tenants with residency=eu and escrow disabled.
carmen: service behavior: if tenant policy == strict -> return 451; if policy == escrow or header==escrow -> accept 202 and return escrow_id. if ephemeral service outage before we can persist escrow -> 503.
alice: UX: SDKs should expose EscrowAccepted (202) vs ResidencyBlocked (451). Console: show live queue length and replay rate, allow manual replay/quarantine download.
bernard: metrics: escrow_in, escrow_replayed, escrow_failed, escrow_pending_ttl_expirations. SLAs: best-effort replay within TTL; strong durability only for ordered-replay paid customers.
carmen: test plan: chaos sim of eu-primary flapping, generate 50k escrow entries, validate replay throughput and idempotency, test quarantine workflow on schema drift.
legal-bot: add RFC appendix with consent wording and default TTL. also review external communications to avoid implying cross-region permanence.
alice: action items: 1) draft RFC for "escrow proxy" with header contract + API sketches (bernard). 2) ops runbook snippet & pager steps (carmen). 3) eng-runtime: implement encrypted escrow + idempotency support.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4002 "escrow-proxy rfc" assigned to bernard due 2024-02-20.
